 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In December 7, 2023 "Danger in the Lone Pine Desert" feat. The Storyteller Squad and Connie Chang Three Black Halflings | A Dungeons & Dragons Podcast 2h 18m Jasper and Jeremy are joined by guest GM Natalie Fuinha of The Storyteller Squad and guest player Connie Chang for a Monster of the Week one shot set in the world of The Storyteller Squad AP series! Join two of the worst men you've ever met and a literal angel as they band together to solve the mystery of what's going on in the city of Lone Pine. Ghosts! Relationship drama! Camels! All this, and more!
